subject: reasoning
question: ‘Numismatics’ is related to ‘Coins’ in the same way as ‘Orography’ is related to ‘_______’.
solution:
The pattern followed here is :

__
 
• Study of **coins** is called **n****umismatics**.

​Similarly,

 
• Study of **mountains** is called **orography**.

​Hence, **"Mountains"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mountains **- Study of mountains is called orography.
 
• Shells - Study of shells is called conchology.
 
• Fossils - Study of fossils is called paleontology.
 
• Eggs - Study of eggs is called oology.

6d
